aspis.speaker: object
aspis.text: If you were a hoplite soldier in the Greek army, your essential everyday weapon was a simple wooden shield called an aspis.

aspis.speaker: object
aspis.text: This round shield was invented in the 8th century B.C. and spread like wildfire across the Mediterranean because of a game-changing innovation:

aspis.speaker: object
aspis.text: the leather back of the shield had two grips, one to secure the elbow and a second one for the hand.

aspis.speaker: object
aspis.text: The aspis got its strength from a wooden core that was reinforced with plates of metal like bronze or iron.
